description: Extended bad weather (rain, fog, no sun for over a week) had a measurable negative effect on crew morale. The Commander remarked: 'It feels like the greyest day of winter.'
response: The Commander acknowledged the morale impact explicitly; indoor work days were used productively. Weather eventually cleared.
lesson: Pre-plan morale activities for multi-day confined periods: communal meals, films, music, games, personal project time. Do not treat rest as wasted time during confinement.
